svg.title: Warden architecture
svg.desc: Requests go from the client through an optional proxy to the port, where the kernel spreads connections over the workers. The warden supervisor, restarted by systemd, spawns and watches the workers over a heartbeat on fd 3 and private health sockets, and reports to wardend, which feeds the GUI and warden events. The CLI talks to each supervisor's own Unix socket. Warden is not on the request path.

svg.text: Warden supervises. The kernel balances. Requests never pass through Warden.
